worldcombat.skill.ragingbull.summary: Lower the horns and charge in a straight line: plow through everything on the way, and the Reflect, Light Screen and Aurora Veil the body actually passes through shatter entirely - empty screens break too, and screens ahead that were never reached are left alone. Its type follows the user's form among Normal, Fighting, Fire and Water.
worldcombat.skill.ragingbull.use.0: Charge through a line of enemies
worldcombat.skill.ragingbull.use.1: Plow through and shatter the screens in the path
worldcombat.skill.ragingbull.use.2: A heavy opener whose type follows the form
worldcombat.skill.ragingbull.description: The charge deals about %1$s contact damage with a %2$s block body radius; its type follows the user's form among Normal, Fighting, Fire and Water, and the target's Defence, type matchup and criticals settle on impact.

Charge up to %1$s blocks at %2$s blocks/tick, stopping early against impassable blocks; a hit shoves the target about %3$s blocks and shatters screens within %4$s blocks of the hit point, while every screen the body actually drives through (empty ones included) breaks from the real path alone.
worldcombat.skill.ragingbull.trample.on: Trample mode: plow through up to four targets, shoving further and shattering wider on impact, at 0.9x per hit and +8 ticks of cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.ragingbull.trample.off: Stop mode: hit only the first target at 1.1x power, shoving less and recovering faster; anyone else on the path is unaffected.
worldcombat.skill.ragingbull.timing: Range %1$s blocks; %2$s s preparation, %3$s s recovery, %4$s PP, %5$s s cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.ragingbull.growth.0: From level %1$s the ram rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.ragingbull.growth.1: From level %1$s the ram rises to %2$s and the charge distance to %3$s.
On: plow through up to four targets, shoving further and shattering wider on impact, at 0.9x per hit and +8 ticks of cooldown. Off: stop at the first target at 1.1x power.
Beyond this distance it closes in instead of charging. Larger values open the charge from further out.
On: rank by the number of enemies along the real charge line from you to the target, favouring lined-up foes or screen corridors. Off: rank by threat and distance only.
world_combat.move.ragingbull.text.miss: Raging Bull charged through empty air
